DeleteWorkspace.note: Open destructive alert renders centred over the bg-black/60 overlay: bg-background panel, border-border, shadow-modal, text-ui title over text-ui-sm muted description, bordered Cancel beside the white primary action. Fully styled with DS tokens, nothing clipped.

ReconcileGitState.note: Ported from WorkspaceReconciliationDialog. Same open surface but with a bordered body block (Monitor / CloudIcon rows, GitBranch meta) between header and footer — proves the content slot composes. Complete and legible.
